parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_sender_updates.requests(request_id,resource,execution_id,context) VALUES($2,$1,$3,$4::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id), acquired AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_sender_updates.locks(resource,request_id,execution_id) SELECT $1,$2,$3 FROM reserved ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING resource) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acquired) AS acquired, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reserved) AS already_used, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM acquired) AS busy;

WITH released AS (DELETE FROM dulcy_sender_updates.locks WHERE resource=$1 AND request_id=$2 AND execution_id=$3 RETURNING resource), audit AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_sender_updates.requests(request_id,resource,execution_id,context) SELECT $2||':released',$1,$3,jsonb_build_object('purpose','replenishment-mutex-released','releasedAt',now()) FROM released ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) AS released, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dulcy_sender_updates.requests WHERE request_id=$2||':released') AS already_released;

WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_sender_updates.requests(request_id,resource,execution_id,context) SELECT $4,$1,$3,$5::jsonb WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dulcy_sender_updates.locks WHERE resource=$1 AND request_id=$2 AND execution_id=$3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dulcy_sender_updates.locks WHERE resource=$1 AND request_id=$2 AND execution_id=$3) AS owned;

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dulcy_sender_updates.locks WHERE resource=$1 AND request_id=$2 AND execution_id=$3) AS owned, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('request_id',request_id,'context',context)) FROM dulcy_sender_updates.requests WHERE resource=$1 AND (request_id=$4 OR left(request_id,length($4)+1)=$4||':')),'[]'::jsonb) AS events;

WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_sender_updates.requests(request_id,resource,execution_id,context) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted;

parameters.jsCode: const p=$('Plan atomic operation').item.json.payload;if(p.ok===false)throw Error('Replenishment coordination blocked: '+JSON.stringify(p));return [{json:p}];
